faq_title: Frequently asked questions about our agency

faq.question: What does adinfinity offer as an advertising agency?
faq.answer: Logo and corporate identity design, printing of every size, shop signage, website and e-shop development, social media and Google/Meta ads management, flyer distribution and promotional gifts, all from our office in Arta.

faq.question: How do you choose an advertising agency in Arta?
faq.answer: Ask to see real projects with client names, published prices, and exactly who will do the work. If an agency cannot show you those three, ask why. Ours are on the Projects, Pricing and About pages.

faq.question: How much does it cost to work with an advertising agency?
faq.answer: Each project is priced on its own: logo from {price:logo}, corporate identity from {price:brandIdentity}, website from {price:websiteStarter}, printing from {price:printsSmall}. Monthly digital marketing packages start from {price:socialMonthly}/month. Every price is on the pricing page. Custom packages based on needs.

faq.question: How long do projects take?
faq.answer: A logo in 3-5 working days, corporate identity in 2-4 weeks, a website in 2-4 weeks, printing in 2-3 working days and signage in 5-7 working days. Digital marketing campaigns are monthly engagements.

faq.question: Do you provide support after delivery?
faq.answer: Yes. Websites with monthly maintenance packages, signage with service and repair, and for everything else you reach us at +30 2681 303007 or at the office at Vas. Pyrrou 30.

faq.question: Do you serve clients outside Arta?
faq.answer: Yes. Printing, signage and distribution across Epirus. Preveza, Ioannina, Thesprotia. Websites, branding and digital marketing remotely, across Greece and Cyprus.
